scope: Automatically acknowledge the authoritative nine-star level advancement on the real character learning page

behavior.authority: Journey currentLevel and its retained per-level points are authoritative. The model synchronizes the account profile on the first successful journey and whenever the level changes.
behavior.celebration: A locally rewarded challenge return queues the existing celebration after its completed-level ninth-star flight. Closing or continuing only dismisses the acknowledgement; no course or confirmation advances the level.
behavior.recovery: Failed journey reads retain the local reward baseline. Failed profile synchronization retains the saved journey and retries on a later load without replaying an already-consumed star. Unrelated reloads do not create ceremonies.
behavior.history: Old-level history and earned points remain visible. The next level starts at its authoritative zero stars and 下一星 0/60分, retaining the 136×5pt meter.
behavior.legacy: Existing manual-promotion DTOs, snapshot reads and their legacy presentation remain available. The normal learning page no longer opens the special course.

coverage: Ninth-star display receipt survives a changed current level
Profile synchronization precedes acknowledgement, while the ninth-star flight precedes its presentation
Journey and profile-refresh failures recover without duplicate ceremonies
Unrelated reloads synchronize difficulty without a ceremony
Highest-level ninth-star completion does not invent another level
Nine stars do not start a special course or manual promotion

uiTests.coverage: Eight stars at 59/60 points, automatic celebration without a confirmation dialog, dismissal into the new level at zero stars/0/60, retained old-level history and six earned points, no manual promotion button.
uiTests.firstRunNote: The first standard run reached and dismissed the ceremony, then failed only a test lookup for standalone history level text. The history correctly combines that level in its button accessibility label; the corrected assertion and earned-point assertion pass.

visualReview.method: Independent inspection of native simulator screenshots; Computer Use unavailable.
visualReview.result: Passed inspection of standard and compact eight-star page, automatic celebration and acknowledged new-level page with old-level history. New title, progress fraction, celebration message and primary action are readable without overlap; compact history continues in the existing scroll view.
visualReview.limits: Simulator model and interaction verification; no physical-device haptic or frame-rate measurement. Photo assets and legacy ceremony layout unchanged. Preview rewards use only the isolated in-memory service.

preview.result: Installed the latest tested build with Scripts/preview.sh preview achievement-preview and left it open on iPhone 18 Pro.
preview.replay: In preview settings, choose 8 stars, then play one star to see the automatic transition. This isolated replay does not alter an account.

visibilityFollowup.behavior: A hidden learning page queues the same automatic-promotion acknowledgement until visible; swiping back to chat cannot present the ceremony, and consumed acknowledgements do not replay.
visibilityFollowup.preview: Latest tested build installed via Scripts/preview.sh and retained on the existing standard simulator.
